answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the meadow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Every claim climbs the kernel of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the summit re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
